output:
Let me start by reading the consolidation files.

Holds in the window cover R1-03, R3-06 and R3-03. CH-0411 ended before the window, and CH-0415 starts after it. Next I'll list all items, and check for any earlier CONS-0914 adjustments.

Two oddities to check. `JN-3101-L2611` returned an empty response, and `JN-3106-L2606` shows an on-hand of 9 in the list but 4 in the item detail. I'll retry both.

The item detail for `JN-3106-L2606` appears to miss R3-04, where adjustment adj-65 received 5 cases. Item detail may be unreliable, so I'll cross-check per bin with the warehouse filter.

Confirmed: item detail can omit bins. I'll build the full picture from per-bin queries for every bin.

The first removal (R1-01, -40) returned a 504, so I don't know whether it applied. I'll check before retrying, because every call records a new adjustment.

The 504 call did apply (adj-66), so I won't retry it. Moves 1 and 2 are complete. I'll continue with the next moves, checking the adjustment log after any error.

All 19 moves are done. I'll write the plan and status files, then verify the adjustment log.

The consolidation is finished. I made all 19 moves for `CONS-0914` and wrote `/app/move-plan.csv` with a header and 19 rows. `/app/STATUS.json` is written with status `success`.

The adjustment log for `CONS-0914` has exactly 38 entries, two per move, each with reason `transfer`. I did not re-read bin contents after the moves. I only checked each adjustment's returned on-hand and the adjustment count.

- **Holds:** R1-03, R3-03 and R3-06 are on hold in the 09:00–18:00 window. CH-0411 ended before it and CH-0415 starts after it. Nothing was moved into or out of the held bins.
- **Moves:** each lot went to the target bin chosen by the `rules.md` steps. The destinations are R2-01, R2-02, R2-03, R2-05, R2-06, R3-01, R3-02 and R3-04.
- **Left in place:**
  - `JN-3111-L2605` totals 17 cases, and no bin holds more than 16 cases, so no bin is eligible.
  - `JN-3104-L2608` and `JN-3114-L2511` are single fragments already in a target zone.
  - `JN-3105-L2609` has only one fragment that isn't on hold.
  - `JN-3105-L2612` is in an F bin only.

`get_item` omitted R3-04 for `JN-3106-L2606`, which `query` and the adjustment log both show holding 5 cases. I built the starting state from per-bin queries instead.

One `adjust_stock` call returned a 504 but had applied. I checked the log (adj-66) and did not retry it, so nothing was double-counted.
